sources.snippet: GLM-5.2-MXFP4 is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find GLM-5.2-MXFP4 on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of GLM-5.2-MXFP4 install, users can directly use GLM-5.2-MXFP4 installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial. It also supports api for free installation.
